FAQs
FREQUENTLY
ASKED
QUESTIONS
What exactly is the Artificial Intelligence Essentials (AIE) program?
AIE is a nontechnical, foundational AI certification program designed to establish a global baseline of AI literacy. This hands-on course introduces you to the core principles of AI, essential tools, and real-world applications. It’s your first step into AI.
Is this an AI course for technical people only?
No. AIE is designed for professionals, students, managers, and decision-makers who interact with AI tools or AI-driven outcomes, but don’t code for a living. You don’t need a technical background to join this program.
What do people actually learn in this course?
You will understand what AI is and how it works, explore common AI tools in everyday work, learn the basic building blocks behind AI systems, practice crafting effective prompts, and discover how to use AI ethically and safely in real-world scenarios.
Does this course include prompt engineering?
Yes. The program includes hands-on prompt engineering training. You learn how to structure prompts for clarity, accuracy, and usefulness, improving how you interact with modern AI tools at work and in daily use.
Do I get an AI certification after finishing the course?
Yes. After completing the program and passing the AIE exam, you will receive an official AI certification from EC-Council. This credential validates your understanding of AI fundamentals, ethical considerations, and responsible AI usage.
